records.question: If I'm already in the negative, will my debit card still work at the store?
records.answer: Whether your debit card works at the store depends on whether you have opted in to overdraft coverage and how far negative your account is [7]. records.question: Summarize all the rules in the fraud memo.
records.answer: The real-time card fraud rules effective from March 1, 2026, include Rule R-101 (Velocity), which declines the sixth and later card-not-present purchases and texts the customer when there are six or more within 10 minutes [6]. Rule R-104 (Geo-jump) declines the second purchase and places a soft block when there are two card-present purchases more than 500 miles apart within 2 hours [6]. Rule R-110 (First foreign use) triggers step-up verification in the app for a first-ever foreign purchase over $400 [6]. Rule R-117 (Merchant risk) holds purchases for analyst review up to 4 hours when the merchant category is high risk and the amount is over $250 [6]. Rule R-122 (New-device spend) declines purchases over $1,000 within 24 hours of a new device enrolling and requires a call to Customer Care [6]. Rule R-130 (ATM pattern) blocks ATM access for 24 hours following 3 or more out-of-network ATM withdrawals in one day at different terminals [6].
